headline: How long do I wait for him to commit this time?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The picture was hidden, but your hand found the card ready to act.
Both hands are working above a table full of tools.
You asked how long to wait for him to commit this time. The action already on the table catches me.
He has not committed, and you are waiting for a limit the relationship has not given you.
Whatever has hold of the commitment keeps action separate from the answer. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the commitment…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs gave no clue, yet you reached for the one caught at one point.
One rope holds one ankle. Everything else hangs loose.
You asked for the length of the wait. This card makes me look at the single rope.
Still, the commitment remains suspended while you ask how long.
Just as the wait would become a decision, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look at what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed you the card, but your hand went to the one travelling light.
The small bundle on his stick is all he is carrying.
You asked how long you wait. The light bundle holds my attention.
But his answer has not come, and you are still asking how long to wait.
Something sits between the relationship and his commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me see what's there…
